name: mechanism-explainer
description: Write an explainer page that answers one question per section with dragon figures, and print it to a PDF

interface.longDescription: Writes an explainer of a system, a mechanism, or a piece of research in HTML: one page for five or fewer questions on one kind of material, or an overview page and one page per topic for six or more questions or more than one kind of material, with the mechanism before its records and reference material and a side menu of topics, questions, and the headings of the open page instead of tabs. Each section answers one question: the question, a one-sentence answer, then a page divided by `####` headings with one figure that follows the flow or the mechanism, at most two, and tables or code where they are enough. The figures come from the dragon notation, and boxes with notes open a card just below them. The skill plans the questions and figures first, checks the notation and the layout with dragon, exports the page with dragon, and prints the page to a PDF.
defaultPrompt: Write an explainer of how OAuth sign-in works, one question per section
